lines.reference: Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Iwisa Super Maize Meal label via Checkers: 1434 kJ = 343 kcal, P 7.5, F 1.0, available carbohydrate 75 g, fibre 4.8 g / 100 g: 343 kcal / 100 g
Clover Amasi via fatsecret.co.za: 63 kcal, P 3.2, F 3.4 / 100 ml; per 100 g at 1.03 g/ml: 61 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions: optional 1 tsp butter counted as written; amasi from the Clover figure at 1.03 g/ml; all of the litre served. Per serving: 100 g dry maize meal (~343 kcal) and 250 ml amasi (~160 kcal). Sanity check: no published per-serving figure; the parts match published values — Wikipedia gives amasi 64 kcal/100 g (Clover 63), and Food & Home's umphokoqo uses the same 400 g maize meal to 1 l amasi.
